svg.title: A small neural network asked 'Is it a cat?': a photo of a cat feeds three input units, then three, then two, then one output unit, with connections of different thickness. The network answers 0.7; red arrows carry the error, 0.3, back through the layers. A caption notes that after each pass the answer improves from 0.7 to 0.73, 0.77 and 0.93 as the error falls from 0.3 to 0.27, 0.23 and 0.07.
